headline: Proposal to triple the scale of the national crude oil reserve storage
summary: Vietnam's reserves cover only 33-36 days of net imports against a 2030 target of about 90 days. The ministry proposes raising each of three 1-million-tonne facilities to a maximum of 3 million tonnes.
why: Strategic crude reserves cushion economies against supply disruptions, and Vietnam's import dependence makes reserve levels relevant to its energy security.
